hints.title: Fixed Window Size
hints.text: A k-radius subarray centered at index i requires elements from index i - k to index i + k, spanning exactly 2k + 1 items.

hints.title: Rolling Sum Calculation
hints.text: Advance the window by adding the incoming element and subtracting the element leaving the left edge.

hints.title: Boundary Initialization
hints.text: Prepopulate the result array with -1 for all positions where the full radius cannot fit within array bounds.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def getAverages(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        ans = [-1] * n
        window_size = 2 * k + 1

        if window_size > n:
            return ans

        curr_sum = sum(nums[:window_size])
        ans[k] = curr_sum // window_size

        for i in range(k + 1, n - k):
            curr_sum += nums[i + k] - nums[i - k - 1]
            ans[i] = curr_sum // window_size

        return ans
```

complexity.space: O(1) extra space beyond output array
complexity.notes: Window size is fixed at 2 * k + 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing each window from scratch results in quadratic O(N * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining a rolling sum avoids repeatedly adding overlapping elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should maintain rolling sum of window length 2k + 1.
